Synthesise the fourth opinion for a pass (Stage-0 SS1 flow)

Source: R/synthesise.R
synthesise.Rd

Resolves the battery, fits each opinion lens, assembles pointwise log-likelihoods, applies the PSIS gate, stacks the survivors, and reports a weight-concentration diagnostic — or returns a first-class abstention() when fewer than two independent opinion lenses survive. The result is either a koine_result or a koine_abstention, never a silent partial.

Usage

synthesise(
  pass,
  registry = koine_stage1_registry(),
  on_degenerate = c("flag", "abstain"),
  keep_fits = FALSE
)

Arguments

pass

A koine_pass.

registry

A registry list; defaults to koine_stage1_registry().

on_degenerate

What to do when the stacking weights are degenerate (the battery corroborated rather than diversified): "flag" (default) returns the opinion with the degeneracy recorded in its diagnostics; "abstain" returns a weight_degenerate abstention (SS8).

keep_fits

If TRUE, attach the contributing per-lens fits to the result (its fits field), so koine_opinion_draws() can materialise the stacking-mixture posterior without re-fitting. Default FALSE (the diagnostic-only contract is unchanged).

Value

A koine_result or a koine_abstention.

Examples

d <- data.frame(y = rnorm(30), x = rnorm(30))
pass <- koine_pass(y ~ x, d, gaussian())
# with a single-lens battery, koine abstains rather than guessing
res <- synthesise(pass, registry = list(koine_stage1_registry()[[1]]))
is_abstention(res)
#> [1] TRUE
